source: Six URLs directly supplied by owner for A.D Scout
note: Candidate registry only; none of these additions constitutes proof of a deployed or working ingester.
ranking_rules: Recency of publication is not urgency of the business event.
A brand mentioned in the news is not automatically a prospect.
An expired popup is historical market intelligence, not a future activation.
Unknown needs, budget and decision makers remain null; never fabricate.
Promotional agency copy must be flagged and corroborated.
EMV is a vendor-estimated exposure metric, not revenue, sales or marketing ROI.
Only corroborated source events may drive prospect alerts; no autonomous outreach or NOW tasks.
integration: Inspect latest branch HEAD and live source adapters before editing.
Verify legal access, robots.txt and applicable terms before enabling each feed.
Keep unavailable websites as explicit blocked/metadata-only entries.
Connect permitted news sections or feeds, not unverified homepages.
Deduplicate same event across publishers; retain original citations.
Make publication date distinct from event date and deadline.
Preserve all old Sources, Saver, Taste, OAuth and Grok gateway boundaries.
Test using real permitted fetches, persistent storage and explainable ranking.
